record.question: Which leader strongly opposed the Partition and advocated Hindu-Muslim unity till the end?
record.explanation: Answer B: Mahatma Gandhi. Gandhi opposed Partition and continued to advocate Hindu–Muslim unity until the end of his life. Reference: https://www.gandhiheritageportal.org/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
